finding: Resource return and user-visible/current-holder publication are distinct. The observed Q publication lag was479880ms even though the selected PG child took2867ms. Failed acceptance did not mean continued resource use.
recommendedManagerDiscipline: Consume exact RETURN first and publish a minimal current holder update immediately; review/seal/intake remain independent.

Use one current holder/next decision across first-screen/current subrecords; reject inconsistent named-current fields at the small publication boundary. Preserve historical events separately and verbatim.
Archive/hashes later in a natural batch and only verify new/changed original files; metadata does not justify product reruns.
Record start/finish and waiting intervals in existing owner status with actual evidence, keeping unknown times unknown. Avoid estimating implementation duration from claim/mtime.
causalLimits: This record measures receipt-to-publication gaps only. It does not establish how much time was spent in hash checking, tool waits, model reasoning or communication, and does not infer service downtime started at these task timestamps.
constraints: No process, DB or filesystem rescan
